title: GCB App
description: Eliminating transfer friction, reducing support tickets, and building transaction confidence.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: Reducing transaction friction and customer support load
body: Vague confirmation states in the legacy banking app led to hesitation, abandoned transfers, and high customer support ticket volume. I redesigned core mobile banking flows to clarify account status and make transfers instantaneous and reassuring.

sections.label: Process
sections.heading: Identifying friction points in daily transfers
body: User testing revealed customers stalled at final transfer steps because confirmation screens lacked explicit success feedback. I restructured navigation around daily tasks and replaced internal banking jargon with plain language.
bullets: Replaced internal banking jargon with plain, direct labels.
Placed account balances and frequent contacts directly on the main screen.
Added explicit success feedback to eliminate user doubt during transfers.

sections.label: Result
sections.heading: 22% higher transfer completion and 38% fewer tickets
body: Rebuilt the primary transfer flow into a single-surface screen with persistent account context. The redesign increased transfer completion by 22% and reduced billing-related support tickets by 38%.
bullets: Keeps sender context visible throughout payment steps to prevent input errors.
Presents high-contrast confirmation summary immediately after transfer submission.

sections.label: Reflection
sections.heading: Clarity directly impacts retention and trust
body: Clear status feedback builds customer trust faster than raw loading speeds. Removing UX ambiguity directly translates into measurable cost savings by decreasing support volume and driving repeat usage.
